name: Product Specifications Tab for WooCommerce
author: Md. Mostak Shahid

sections.description:
Product Specifications Tab for WooCommerce allows you to display detailed product information in a clean, structured, and professional specification table inside a dedicated WooCommerce product tab.

Clear product information builds trust. The more organized and detailed your product data is, the easier it becomes for customers to make confident purchase decisions.

This plugin helps you:

  • Display unlimited product specifications
  • Organize technical details in structured tables
  • Improve product page SEO
  • Reduce customer confusion
  • Increase buyer confidence
  • Lower return rates

Built with performance in mind — it is lightweight and will not slow down your website.

Why Product Specifications Matter

Modern customers compare products carefully. A structured specification table:

  • Builds credibility
  • Improves conversion rates
  • Reduces pre-sales questions
  • Enhances product clarity
  • Strengthens search visibility

If you sell technical, configurable, or detailed products, structured specifications are essential.

Free Version Features

  • Unlimited specification rows
  • Create multiple specification tables
  • Drag & drop reordering
  • Sort specifications easily
  • Tooltip support
  • Responsive and mobile-friendly layout
  • Clean and modern table design
  • Custom CSS and JS panel for advanced users
  • Lightweight and optimized performance

Upgrade to Pro (Coming Soon)

The Pro version will introduce powerful advanced features:

  • Global specification templates
  • Apply specifications to multiple products at once
  • Import and export specifications
  • Advanced styling presets
  • Custom icon support
  • Conditional display rules
  • Priority support
  • More premium enhancements

Stay tuned for the Pro release.

Perfect For

This plugin is ideal for:

  • Electronics stores
  • Industrial equipment suppliers
  • Apparel and fashion brands
  • Medical and laboratory equipment
  • Digital product sellers
  • Any WooCommerce store requiring detailed product data

How to Use

  1. Edit any WooCommerce product
  2. Go to the Product Data section
  3. Click on the Specifications tab
  4. Add unlimited specification rows
  5. Save the product

The specification table will automatically display on the product page.
sections.installation:
Using WordPress Dashboard

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New
  2. Click Upload Plugin
  3. Upload the plugin ZIP file
  4. Click Install Now
  5. Activate the plugin

Manual Installation via FTP

  1. Extract the plugin ZIP file
  2. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  3. Activate the plugin from the WordPress Plugins menu
sections.faq:
Is there any limitation?

No. You can add unlimited specifications and multiple tables.

Does this plugin affect site speed?

No. The plugin is optimized for performance and does not add unnecessary load time.

Does it work with all themes?

It works with most WooCommerce-compatible themes. If you encounter any issues, please open a support ticket.

Where can I find documentation?

Documentation is available at:
https://www.mdmostakshahid.com/mos-product-specifications-tab/

Where can I get support?

You can use the WordPress.org support forum from the plugin page.
